hero.subtitle: Krishi Sathi connects farmers, experts, and communities across Nepal, helping every harvest start with better knowledge.

about.title: Technology that walks the fields with you.
about.description: Krishi Sathi is a smart agriculture platform that connects farmers, experts, and communities. Our goal is simple: make farming easier through technology, shared knowledge, and teamwork, right from the field.

missionVision.missionText: Help farmers by providing a simple platform to learn, connect, and share agricultural knowledge.
missionVision.visionText: Build a trusted digital farming community that supports innovation and sustainable agriculture.

features.title: Built for how farmers actually work.
features.item1Text: A simple interface built for every farmer, regardless of tech experience.
features.item2Text: Learn together with farmers and experts across Nepal.
features.item3Text: Works smoothly on every device, from the field to the office.

team.title: Meet our development team.
team.subtitle: We are a group of students working together to build Krishi Sathi, a platform for smarter agriculture.

login.title: Good to see you again.
login.welcome: Welcome back to the community keeping Nepal's fields growing.

register.title: Join the community.
register.welcome: Bring your field online with knowledge, market prices, and community all in one place.

dashboard.tip1: Water early morning or evening to reduce loss to evaporation.
dashboard.tip2: Rotate crops each season to keep soil nutrients balanced.
dashboard.tip3: Check leaves weekly for early signs of pest damage.
